name: garden
description: A minimal CLI orchestrator for managing Claude Code sessions across multiple projects.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --keep-names --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --define:__GARDEN_VERSION__='"'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)'"' && esbuild src/hook-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --keep-names --outfile=dist/hook.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --define:__GARDEN_VERSION__='"'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)'"'
